milestones.title: The Awakening of the Kami
milestones.description: Seek guidance from the ancient mountain shrine, commune with the wounded Kami, and defend the village from corrupt yokai.

milestones.title: The Blood Gate Siege
milestones.phase: Act 1 Finale - Fortress of the Betrayer
milestones.description: Infiltrate the mountain fortress, breach the inner sanctum, and defeat the corrupted clan warlord.

milestones.title: Descent into Yomi
milestones.description: Cross the boundary into the shadowy underworld of Yomi, retrieving lost divine artifacts amidst legions of tortured spirits.

milestones.title: The Dark Shogun's Downfall
milestones.description: Confront the Dark Shogun at the heart of the cursed capital, shattering the ancient seal to restore honor to Japan.

milestones.title: Eternal Blades of Honor
milestones.description: Complete all independent heroic trials, master the forbidden arts, and forge an everlasting legacy for future generations.
